stones.label: Zero Walls, Zero Ceilings, Zero Floors
stones.causal_role: Whether unfinished or demolished, by enchantment or whim, Armilla has no walls, no ceilings, and no floors—only open cerulean sky through every story.

stones.label: Vertical Risers Where Houses Should Be
stones.causal_role: Bundles of copper, brass, and verdigris standpipes rise vertically from ground intakes to trace the ghost-volumes of multi-story dwellings.

stones.label: Horizontal Pipe-Runs Where Floors Should Be
stones.causal_role: Branching manifolds spread horizontally at staggered floor elevations, outlining invisible rooms in pure air.

stones.label: Taps, Showers, Sifons, and Overflows
stones.causal_role: Every conduit terminates in brass stopcocks, faucets, perforated shower roses, gooseneck S-trap sifons, and basin overflows.

stones.label: White Porcelain Perched Like Late Fruit on Boughs
stones.causal_role: Against the sky gleams the white glaze of clawfoot bathtubs, pedestal lavabos, bidets, and porcelain bowls/funnels cantilevered on hydraulic boughs.

stones.label: Suspended Mirrors & Glass Brackets
stones.causal_role: Beveled oval mirrors and glass brackets clamped directly onto standpipes catch sunlit spray and sky reflections.

stones.label: Morning Possession by Young Nymphs and Naiads
stones.causal_role: Unhaunted by angry subterranean gods, Armilla's intact plumbing belongs cleanly to slender nymphs and naiads splashing, stretching in bathtubs, arching under showers, combing long hair at suspended mirrors, and singing in sunlit morning waterjets.

calvino_source.inner_arch: Abandoned unfinished before bricklayers arrived or demolished leaving only indestructible plumbing intact, Armilla incurs no wrath of subterranean water-gods; instead its aerial forest of pipes and sky-perched white porcelain has been given over to young slender nymphs and naiads splashing, combing their long hair at suspended mirrors, and singing amid sunlit morning waterjets, showers, and soapy foam.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Interactive axonometric hydraulic pipe-cathedral against open cerulean sky—zero walls, ceilings, or floors—coupled to sunlit parabolic water-arc physics, prismatic mist rainbows, joyful naiad silhouettes on sky-perched porcelain boughs, and a valve-routed water-organ & vocal-formant WebAudio morning hymn, paired with Royal Plate Guild cartography (map.png / map.svg) and architectural plate (image.png).
anti_trude_vector.typography: Self-contained system engraved/humanist serif ('Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Georgia, serif) paired with crisp hydraulic drafting monospace ('SF Mono', 'Menlo', monospace); zero external font CDNs.

invariants.zero_masonry_law: Armilla strictly maintains wallCount === 0, ceilingCount === 0, and floorSlabCount === 0 across all camera angles and states; only vertical pipe risers, horizontal manifold runs, brass stopcocks, sifons, mirrors, and white porcelain stand against open sky.
invariants.hydraulic_hymn_law: Opening/closing brass stopcocks ([1]..[6] or setAllValves) causally routes mainhead pressure through risers into projected outlets, scaling activeJetCount, spumeBubbleCount, rainbowVisibility, and singingVoiceCount in the morning water-organ & vocal-formant hymn (0 singing voices when all valves closed; 6 singing voices + sunlit mist rainbow when all 6 open).
